problem: A transient Codespaces discovery/state read immediately failed a launch; a resume request could be accepted despite an error response. Earlier upstream failures do not retain their exact HTTP status.

behavior.uncertainResume: Observe the same named environment within its provisioning deadline; do not provision an empty replacement.

externalRecovery.scope: Passed before the retry code was deployed; demonstrates unchanged data in the original environment, not that the new retry logic caused provider recovery.

validationScope: Provider failures are injected in deterministic tests. Live healthy provider acceptance is separate.
